name: My Lucky Charm Scoop 🤍  [BUGS FIXED]
desc:
MY LUCKY CHARM SCOOP ♡ 

Welcome to your very own lucky charm scoop shop! 🥄

🎶 Scoop charms
🦢 Pack customer orders
⭐ Customise your website 
🗝️ Collect rewards and grow your shop!

Every scoop brings a new surprise! What will your customers get? ^_^

♡ Have fun scooping! ♡

Thanks for playing too!!

llm.loop: receive customer orders -> scoop charms -> pack orders -> earn cash -> buy trolleys, stickers and decor to grow and customize the shop
llm.objectives: run and grow your own lucky charm scoop shop
llm.progression: cash, shop growth, trolleys/baskets, decor and website customization
llm.instructions: scoop charms, pack customer orders, customize your website, collect rewards and grow your shop
unique: based on the TikTok/ASMR 'charm scoop' small-business trend
llm.thumbnails: chibi anime girl with a bowl of colorful charms; a real-life photo of a hand scooping charm beads from a bowl
llm.complexity_notes: single-player shop interior, scoop and packing interactions, order UI, decor placement
